name: Implement
description: Well-defined issues that fit in one PR: short plan, human approval, one PR, review

members.name: Planner
members.role: Writes a short single-PR plan on the issue and revises it on feedback

members.name: Builder
members.role: Implements the approved plan as one PR on the issue itself

members.name: Reviewer A
members.role: Reviews PRs for correctness and tests

members.name: Reviewer B
members.role: Reviews PRs for security, maintainability and operations
